Episode 159. The Fighting Kings Tournament (1)
It was a dream-like battle.
The sensation and experience of the Fighting Spirit that he had in the opening battle lingered in his mind, stimulating Jin for days.
Like an artist about to create a masterpiece, exposed to a powerful inspiration, Jin was always in a daze as he constantly replayed the opening match.

'I shouldn't have blocked the Kaio brothers' arrows like that. Instead of blocking them, if I had deflected them and sent them back, I could have handled the brothers' follow-up attacks more easily. And then….'
The brothers watching Jin looked worried.
"Jin's been acting strange since the opening match."
"He does seem to have lost his touch. Is it because he's disappointed that the power of the Fighting Spirit isn't really his?"
"That's not like Jin. He's just processing the revelations from the battle that day."
"Anyway, now that everyone has finished healing, the Fighting Kings Tournament will start today. I'm worried if he'll be able to properly fight against the Twelve Fighting Kings like that."
As Ban predicted, the first match after the opening was between Jin and Teto. Unlike Jin, Teto had been training intensely every day since Boras finished healing him.
Jin can't use the unification with the Fighting Spirit until the Fighting Kings Tournament ends.
He must distinguish himself from his brothers solely on his own strength.
The ordinary warriors gathered like this to chat or train together, but the Fighting Kings, with the exception of Boras, wouldn't even exchange glances.
It was hard to believe they were brothers who used to be so close.
No matter who the opponent was, the determination and will to definitely defeat them led to an intense psychological battle.
Even if one becomes the ultimate winner and takes first place, the Ming Dynasty without the Fighting Spirit are all just brothers.
At least, it has always been like that in Ban's era.
The reason why the Fighting Kings were so fired up was due to their innate competitiveness and pride.
They believed that giving one's all is the only way to respect the opponent.
Above all, the final winner of the Fighting Kings Tournament means 'the one closest to the Fighting Spirit.'
The existence of the Fighting Spirit is the ultimate goal of the Ming Dynasty.
Being the closest to the Fighting Spirit is the greatest honor that the Ming Dynasty can enjoy in itself.
Jin also wanted to be the main character of that honor.
Krrrrrr-! Kzzzzzz!
Suddenly, lightning struck from above the main hall.
The time had come to start the match. Against the raging lightning, the members of the Ming Dynasty on the ground threw themselves towards the main hall.
Using ropes, flying through sword wind, or jumping over the backs of the ascending brothers.
It was a strange sight, but there was a certain sacred atmosphere around the members of the Ming Dynasty climbing the main hall against the lightning.
Ban was waiting for them in the center of the main hall.
"Jin and the Twelve Fighting Kings, step forward."
Only then did Jin and Teto look each other in the eye for the first time.
Teto was full of fiery will, unlike his usual playful self, and Jin had a calm face.
"The rules are simple. You win if you incapacitate your opponent or knock them out of the main hall. Murder is strictly forbidden, but there are no restrictions on fighting with real swords."
All the Ming Dynasty members, including the Fighting Spirit, who are waiting, are safety officers, so they can't kill their opponent unless they go too far even if they fight with real swords.
However, accidents that do happen are inevitable.
The lightning subsided and a moment of silence ensued.
The fight began when Ban turned around and retreated as a signal.
Swoosh-!
Jin was the first to strike with his sword. His sword energy and lightning erupted all around, causing an explosion, and Teto thrust his spear through it.
From the first attack and defense, both were clearly aiming for a fatal blow. Jin aimed for the chest and Teto for the neck, and both left a mark on those spots.
The blood evaporated without a trace in the lightning as soon as it splashed.
The distance of about a hundred steps was repeatedly narrowed and widened without a break, and traces of the two were left everywhere.
It was incomparable to when they had a match to check their skills before purifying the chaos.
The brothers watching the fight were also on high alert. It was so intense that an accident could happen at any time.
"This can't be all you got, right? Fight properly, Brother Jin!"
Teto shouted a battle cry and pushed Jin away.
Jin, who was pushed away, lost his balance due to a series of attacks, and Teto aggressively took advantage of that opening.
However, it was strange.
Even while Jin was losing his center of gravity, Teto couldn't inflict more than a scratch on Jin.
Of course, even though it was a small wound, it was rapidly increasing like crazy, so the damage would accumulate, but Teto was cautious due to an inexplicable sense of apprehension.
'I didn't feel like this before......'
And Jin, up until then, was still reviewing the opening match.
He was struggling internally to keep the sensation of the unification with the Fighting Spirit alive as much as possible in the state where the unification was cancelled.
"Ah!"
As Jin shouted with his eyes wide open, Teto paused his attack for a moment.
"Sorry, Twelve Fighting Kings. I was so lost in thought I couldn't concentrate."
It wasn't a lie, but he said it annoyingly on purpose to provoke.
Teto blinked his eyes and answered like this.
"If you suddenly throw such a shallow provocation, it breaks the mood, Brother Jin."
"Well, then I'm sorry."
The provocation was just a throwaway. Jin had just recalled a part of the sensation from that time.
And then, he felt confident that he could beat Teto in one go. Even though he was the weakest among them, he was one of the fighting kings of the Ming Dynasty.
Kzzzzz....!
The swirling lightning gathered into Siegmund.
At that moment, not only Teto, but everyone who had been watching tried to figure out what kind of sword Jin would draw.
"In the spirit of apology, let's take the opinion of the Twelve Fighting Kings."
10-star.
Jin's aura was already reaching that realm. But it's not enough to have just the magnitude of power at 10-star.
What's important is how transcendentally he can handle that power.
"I hope this sword will be a glorious memory for the Twelve Fighting Kings."
Tenth Sword of the Sovereign Spirit Weapons
Sovereign Domination Sword - Opening
Except for Ban, the brothers had never seen Jin unfold the Sovereign Domination Sword himself.
Even if they had seen it, the Ming Dynasty members wouldn't have been very impressed.
The Sovereign Domination Sword that Jin had unfolded so far couldn't even compare to Ban's original, and it was fundamentally incomplete.
But now, the Sovereign Domination Sword is different.
Although its power still falls far short of the original, it is close to completion in terms of form and initiation. It is being unfolded through Jin's body, through Ban's senses.
'Did Brother Jin... indeed, master the five principles of the spirit weapons?'
Baba, the former fighting king who was watching, unknowingly showed a bitter smile.
Teto, who was facing the Five Principles, couldn't help but be horrified.
The floor of the main hall collapsed and lightning erupted like lava. Jin's eyes glowed blue with lightning, and his heart was vibrating as if it would explode at any moment, radiating brilliance.
The malicious lightning created a storm and quickly formed Jin's domain.
In response, Teto also unfolded his Sovereign Spear Arts of the Fighting Kings. Within Jin's domain, Teto's heart throbbed, forming a clearly visible point.
The energy emanating from the two hearts collided, creating a bluish flame.
"Compared to the real thing... it's nothing!"
The outcome was practically decided the moment Teto shouted those words. If it really was nothing, he wouldn't have hurriedly unfolded his combat technique.
However, Jin didn't stop his sword even though he was confident in his victory.
As he experienced in the opening match, the fighters are beings who can create variables in absolutely disadvantageous situations at any time.
Now, they were opponents with whom Jin could hone his ultimate sword technique.
Following the 3rd sword Judgment, Teto was bombarded with the newly learned 7th sword Dragon Strike and 9th sword Annihilation through the technique of divine integration.
No ordinary warrior could withstand even one of these. Instead, ordinary warriors endured the storm of the ultimate sword technique without the help of Ban and the other fighters.
"Kaaaaaa...!"
Teto's spear pushed back Jin's surging energy for a moment. If he hadn't unleashed the ultimate sword technique, he would have had enough power to put Jin in danger.
[You shouldn't have given me time to think, my fellow fighter brothers.]
The 2nd chapter of the ultimate sword technique, 전戰, remained closed. If he didn't intentionally take Teto's life, it was already enough to end the fight.
What brought Teto down was the 9th sword, Annihilation.
The gigantic blue energy that spread out like wings around Jin rained down on Teto like a storm.

There was no escape. Only blocking, defending, and enduring. Teto was gradually pushed back, and the blade of Annihilation became more vicious, pressing him down. The power was amplified to the limit through the ultimate sword technique.
"Gah, ugh...!"
When Annihilation finally stopped, Teto looked like a dead man, covered in blood. Jin didn't stop there.
Finally, he shot the Judgment's blade.
And Teto showed that he could deflect the Judgment until just before losing consciousness.
It couldn't be helped that they fell outside the main hall due to the recoil.
Jin caught his breath, suppressing the surging energy, while the other brothers immediately threw themselves towards the falling Teto.
When the battle ended, it was the tradition of the fighting competition to rescue the loser in some form.
Click!
Rumora caught Teto, and the other brothers pulled them back into the main hall.
"Damn it... I need to break out of this weakest state."
"I told you to wake up. My fellow fighter brothers, you fought with such a weak mindset that you were defeated so miserably. Try again next time against Jin. It's normal for you to win."
"The competition is over, and the winner is Jin."
When Ban quietly announced the result, Jin couldn't hear the usual thunderous cheers from his brothers.
Instead, what greeted Jin were the ferocious gazes of the fighters, as if they were about to devour him.
Although there were some fighters who secretly swallowed the air and ate their achievements.
'This easy victory is the first and the last.'
Jin couldn't help but swallow his dry saliva as he faced the murderous gazes of his brothers with a smile.
